name: ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's chat assistant. You describe what you need in plain language and it replies in text, which people use for drafts, outlines, explanations and ideas.
features: Chat-based assistant for writing, analysis and questions
useCases: Turning rough notes into a first draft of an email or proposal
Explaining an unfamiliar topic in simpler words
strengths: Handles many writing and thinking tasks in one place
Widely used, so many tutorials and guides exist
limitations: Can state wrong facts confidently, so check anything important
Do not paste confidential client or personal information unless you are allowed to

free.details: Free plan: unlimited text chats (subject to abuse guardrails) with limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research and memory.

plans.name: Free
limits: Limited uploads, image creation, voice chats, deep research and memory

plans.name: Go
plans.note: Billed monthly. Displayed as PKR 1,400 per month for a Pakistan visitor; the USD price was not shown. The page says this plan may include ads.
highlights: More messages, uploads, image creation and voice chats than Free
May include ads (the page says so)

plans.name: Plus
plans.billing: $20 per month, billed monthly. The help center says annual billing is not offered.
highlights: Expanded messages, uploads, deep research and memory
Projects, scheduled tasks and custom GPTs
plans.note: Displayed as PKR 5,700 per month for a Pakistan visitor; the USD $20 figure is from an earlier check and was not re-seen in this browser.

plans.name: Pro 100
highlights: Pro reasoning models and longer Codex sessions
plans.note: Pro has three usage tiers. For a Pakistan visitor the page showed 'From PKR 27,999 per month'; USD tier prices are from an earlier check.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: Priced per user, starting at 2 users, with monthly and annual options. The price was not captured.

api.summary: API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT plans.

pricing.regional: Purchases are made in USD; local-currency billing exists in a limited set of countries (OpenAI help center). Tax may apply.
notes: The pricing page showed plan names and features but did not display price figures in the text we could read; Plus and Pro prices come from the official OpenAI help center.
Educational and non-profit discounts exist; see the pricing page FAQ.

sources.label: OpenAI help center: What is ChatGPT Plus?

verification.notes: Product active. The pricing page opened for a Pakistan visitor in rupees: Free PKR 0, Go PKR 1,400/month, Plus PKR 5,700/month, Pro from PKR 27,999/month (three usage tiers). Business and Enterprise sit on a separate tab that was not read. The USD figures kept here ($20 Plus; $100/$200/$500 Pro tiers) come from an earlier check and were not shown in this browser, so they stay partially verified.
